title: feat(l1src3): shared-face clock-source identity at ticks 3 and 4
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. Completes the #6329 shared-face law across the whole history: Delta rho(A)+Delta rho(B) = F + S also holds at tick 3 (F=3, S=1, dA=1, dB=3, i.e. 1+3 = 3+1) and tick 4 (F=1, S=0, dA=0, dB=1, i.e. 0+1 = 1+0), so the identity is now verified on all four ticks INCLUDING the degenerate S=0 case where no new lock lands on the shared face. Unlike the tree-gauge checks in #6337/#6341, this one is non-vacuous: Delta rho is computed from the successive histories and F,S from the formed sets, so the identity could have failed. 35/35 runner PASS.
